 Vs.
 State of Jk & Ors.
HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE  HON'BLE MR JUSTICE SANJAY DHAR, JUDGE  ORDER 12.07.2021 Heard Mr Sheikh Mohammad Ayoub, petitioner in person who is an advocate by practice.

He has preferred this petition in Public Interest for the implementation of the Food Safety &
Standard Act 2006 and the Rules thereunder in the real spirit and the manner to safeguard the health of the consumers.
There was another PIL No. 3/2016 which was initiated on Suo-Moto action by the court pertaining to the implementation of the aforesaid Act and the Rules.

The said PIL was disposed of vide order dated 24th February 2021 and was directed to be consigned to the record with the hope and trust that the authorities will continue to act most effectively and efficiently and would take all measured precautions so as to ensure that the Food Safety and Standard Act and the Rules thereunder are not violated and the offenders are strictly punished for which purpose regular checking and sampling would be carried out.
There is no grievance or any complaint that after the said order dated 24th February 2021 disposing of the above PIL No. 3/2016 that the Act is not being followed in letter and spirit.
In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, we dispose of the present petition also in terms of the above order.

(SANJAY DHAR) (PANKAJ MITHAL)
